# Review Checklist: Trainer signs up

**Purpose**: Quick author pass over requirements quality in security, UX and accessibility, the API and error contract, and data lifecycle, before `/speckit-tasks`
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/api.md](../contracts/api.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Security and privacy

- [x] CHK001 Is the remaining pre-hijack risk (whoever signed up with another person's email knows the password once the owner confirms) stated as an accepted risk, not only the take-over path? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Does FR-018 (recipient and link written to the log) conflict with the rule that logs hold no personal data, and is the allowed window (until #65) stated in the spec? [Conflict, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK003 Is "response times within the same range" quantified so it can be measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK004 Does "every error response is a problem detail" hold for refusals raised before a request reaches the API (missing anti-forgery token, unauthenticated), or is that exception written down? [Conflict, Spec §FR-020, Research §R3]
- [x] CHK005 Is excluding mass sign-up throttling an explicit, reasoned decision with a follow-up, rather than only "out of scope"? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## UX and accessibility

- [x] CHK006 Are in-progress states defined for submitting the form, confirming a link and requesting a new one? The board shows only four end states. [Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK007 Is it defined what "Check your email" shows after a page reload, when the entered email is no longer known? [Gap, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK008 Is focus placement after each state change (form → check email, confirming → confirmed or expired) specified for keyboard and screen-reader users? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK009 Is the 60-second Resend lock's visible feedback specified (static note or countdown), and how it is announced? [Clarity, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK010 Is the relation between the password help text and its error message specified, so the rules are visible before the first error? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK011 Is the "Sign in" destination's behaviour until sign-in exists (story #18) acceptable and stated? [Dependency, Spec §FR-017]

## API and error contract

- [x] CHK012 Is each field-level failure code in the contract matched by a message requirement in both languages, including the generic fallback per field? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Contract §POST /api/v1/accounts]
- [x] CHK013 Is an invalid time zone's result consistent between spec ("rejected") and contract (no field error), and is the person told anything usable? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Are network failures and a missing backend covered by the generic-message requirement, or only server-reported failures? [Coverage, Spec §US4]

## Data and lifecycle

- [x] CHK015 Are allowed name characters defined beyond length (line breaks, control characters), given the name may appear in emails later? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK016 Is the 24-hour boundary defined as inclusive or exclusive in the spec, not only in the data model? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Data model §Behaviour]
- [x] CHK017 Is it stated that the 60-second mail window updates bookkeeping on a confirmed account, and that this does not count as "changing the account"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK018 Is the documented demo password consistent with "never put credentials in SQL"? [Conflict, backend/CLAUDE.md §Persistence, Data model §Demo data]

## Resolutions (2026-10-19)

- CHK001: accepted risk stated in Spec §Assumptions.
- CHK002: Spec §FR-018 limits recipient and link in the log to local development (Research §R10a).
- CHK003: Spec §SC-002 sets median difference below 100 ms over 20 requests.
- CHK004: Spec §FR-020 covers security-filter refusals; Contract adds `request.unauthenticated` and `request.forbidden`.
- CHK005: reasoned exclusion in Spec §Assumptions, pointing to task #21.
- CHK006: Spec §FR-026 adds busy buttons and the "Confirming your email" state.
- CHK007: Spec §US3 scenario 6 (reload shows the empty form).
- CHK008: Spec §FR-027 (focus to heading, first error, alerts).
- CHK009: Spec §US3 scenario 3 (one announced note, no countdown).
- CHK010: Spec §FR-008 (rules visible from the start, errors on submit then live).
- CHK011: Spec §Assumptions accepts the interim not-found page.
- CHK012: Spec §FR-025 fixes one message per field rule.
- CHK013: Spec §Edge Cases (UTC fallback in the form; altered requests get the generic message).
- CHK014: Spec §US4 scenario 3 and §FR-022 include network failures.
- CHK015: Spec §Edge Cases and Contract (`pattern`) forbid control characters.
- CHK016: Spec §FR-009 (expired at exactly 24 hours).
- CHK017: Spec §FR-006 (mail bookkeeping is not an account change).
- CHK018: Spec §Assumptions and backend/CLAUDE.md §Persistence ("real credentials").

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
